title: EEPROM checksum error
fullDescription: Error 0123 on Acer laptops indicates the BIOS configuration EEPROM checksum failed. Often appears after a failed BIOS update or motherboard battery loss.

fixSteps.title: Load BIOS defaults
fixSteps.instruction: Enter BIOS (F2), load defaults, save and exit.

fixSteps.title: Reflash BIOS
fixSteps.instruction: Use Acer BIOS recovery via USB.

title: RTC / CMOS battery error
fullDescription: Error 1450 on Acer laptops indicates the real-time clock battery is depleted or its connection has come loose, causing CMOS data loss between boots.

title: Battery not detected
fullDescription: Acer laptops show 'No battery is detected' or 'Battery error' when the smart battery cannot communicate with the EC. Common after long storage or battery wear.

fixSteps.title: Reset EC
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect AC, hold power 30 seconds, reconnect.

fixSteps.title: Reseat battery cable
fixSteps.instruction: Open back cover, unplug and replug battery cable.

title: BIOS date/time not set
fullDescription: Acer prompts to enter BIOS to set date and time when CMOS RTC has lost its setting. Usually points to a failing coin cell.
whenToCallPro: If laptop is hard to open.
videoSearchQuery: Acer BIOS date time not set fix

faq.a: Works temporarily but indicates dying battery.

title: No bootable device
fullDescription: Common Acer Aspire issue after Windows update or BIOS reset. Boot mode mismatch or failed SSD typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Check BIOS boot order
fixSteps.instruction: F2, set Windows Boot Manager first.

fixSteps.title: Toggle UEFI/Legacy
fixSteps.instruction: Try opposite boot mode and disable Secure Boot for testing.

fixSteps.title: Repair Windows boot
fixSteps.instruction: Boot from install USB and use bootrec.

title: Loud fan and thermal shutdown
fullDescription: Acer Predator and Nitro gaming laptops commonly suffer thermal issues — fans run at max but CPU still throttles. Causes: dust buildup, dried thermal paste, undersized cooling.

fixSteps.title: Repaste CPU+GPU
fixSteps.instruction: Open laptop, remove heatsink, clean and apply new thermal paste.

videoSearchQuery: Acer Predator overheating loud fan fix

title: Touchpad not responding
fullDescription: Acer laptops have a Fn+F7 hotkey to enable/disable touchpad. Many users accidentally disable it. Driver issues are also common after Windows updates.

fixSteps.title: Enable with Fn+F7
fixSteps.instruction: Press Fn+F7 (or model-specific) to toggle touchpad.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall driver
fixSteps.instruction: Download Acer ELAN/Synaptics driver from support page.

whenToCallPro: If driver/Fn don't help — likely ribbon disconnected.

faq.a: Some models use F6 or have a dedicated key.

title: WHEA uncorrectable error BSOD
fullDescription: WHEA BSOD on Acer laptops typically indicates CPU instability — overclock too aggressive, voltage too low, failing RAM, or overheating CPU.

title: Webcam not working
fullDescription: Acer laptops with privacy shutter or hardware kill switch (Fn+F4 on some models) can disable the camera at hardware level, making it disappear from Device Manager entirely.

fixSteps.title: Check privacy shutter
fixSteps.instruction: Slide physical privacy switch above camera lens to open.

fixSteps.title: Toggle Fn+F4
fixSteps.instruction: Press Fn+F4 to enable webcam if model supports.

title: Powers on but no display
shortDescription: Fans spin, LEDs on, but screen black.
fullDescription: Acer Aspire boots fully (fans, lights) but display stays black. Common causes: failed backlight, loose LCD cable, dead RAM, or failed motherboard.

fixSteps.title: Test external monitor
fixSteps.instruction: Connect HDMI to external display. If works, panel/cable issue.

fixSteps.title: Reseat RAM
fixSteps.instruction: If no external image either, reseat RAM modules.

fixSteps.title: Replace LCD or cable
fixSteps.instruction: Open bezel, replace eDP cable or panel.

faq.a: Shine flashlight on screen — if you see faint image, backlight is dead.
